g.text: QUIC service during 20% loss and after loss clears
500 Mbps · 70/30 ms · 20% DOWN loss, 0% UP loss · no injected jitter · 40 s offered load
Loss guide at 20 s is nominal probe time. Observed clear on the separate profile clock — Prior: 20.694 s; Candidate: 20.197 s.
DOWN uses ordered receiver bytes; confirmation/buffer release can produce bins above the physical link rate.
One observation per version; no smoothing or variability bands. Defaults: prior 10%/10%; candidate 20%/20%.
Echo markers above the axis: × failed attempt, | unavailable; neither is a latency value. Exact samples/outcomes accompany the SVGs.
